issue.title: Xprompt project tags (+sase)
issue.description: Prompts name their project with a `+<project>` project tag by default. SASE resolves the tag to the project's VCS type and runs the same `#gh:`/`#git:` workflow as before. Every completion surface (TUI, LSP/Neovim, shell) inserts tags. Every surface that shows raw prompts renders tags in the project's accent color. Project names are enforced unique, case-insensitively, across all VCS types.

issue.title: sase-core project tag lexer, resolver, expander, and bindings
issue.description: core-tags: add the sase_core project_tag module (tag scanning with literal-zone skipping, anchored-position detection, case-insensitive resolution with suggestions, in-place expansion to VCS refs, completion trigger and selection-apply), the v5 catalog wire types, and Python bindings.

issue.title: Case-insensitive project name uniqueness across VCS types
issue.description: unique-names: make every write-time project ref check case-insensitive and reserve home. Widen doctor project.name_collisions to every key/name/alias conflict, and mirror the rule in sase-core collision warnings and sase-github name allocation. Then verify this machine has no collisions.

issue.title: Python project tag backend and launch integration
issue.description: backend: shared accent module, cached project tag catalog, expansion inside prompt canonicalization and launch_query, launch-unit validation, tag-aware helpers for raw-text consumers, generators that default to tags, and the v5 LSP catalog payload. Also moves the core pin.

issue.title: sase-xprompt-lsp project tag support
issue.description: lsp: tag completion with in-place edits, semantic tokens with accent modifiers plus a palette capability, hover, diagnostics, quick fixes and a rewrite-to-tag code action, and leading-project detection that understands tags.

issue.title: TUI prompt editor completion and tag defaults
issue.description: tui-editor: the + trigger through the core binding, in-place accept, accent-styled completion rows ordered current-project-first, tag prefills and MRU cycling, editor project context from tags, pre-submit tag validation, and shell completion for +.

issue.title: Tag rendering in the agent panel and prompt editor
issue.description: tag-display: the humanizer renders project refs as tags; the shared tokenizer emits project_tag spans; accent styles in both highlight systems; the prompt editor, the AGENT XPROMPT sections (main, family, hint, and clan), and their visual snapshots.

issue.title: Accent-colored tags on every remaining raw-prompt surface
issue.description: tag-surfaces: prompt history, stash, launch approval, runners/revive/run-log previews, the metadata pager, the ACE query +project shorthand, CLI prompt output, and the sase project list/show TAG column and JSON fields.

issue.title: sase-nvim project tag highlighting and picker
issue.description: nvim: accent highlight groups built from the server palette, a semantic-token handler for saseProjectTag, + support in the Ctrl+T picker, README, and smoke tests.

issue.title: sase-telegram and sase-github tag adoption
issue.description: plugins: Telegram project-context capture and copy-text buttons use tags, its inbound docs and tests are updated, and sase-github docs present +<project> as the default.
